kurz: If it gets too hot, sugar, protein and fat break down into bitter, black substances. Roasted aroma turns into burnt flavour.
bild_im_kopf: Like toast that stayed in the toaster a moment too long.
was_passiert: After the [[maillard-reaktion|Maillard reaction]] and [[karamellisierung|caramelisation]] comes decomposition: the molecules break apart, and carbon, smoke and bitter substances form. Small, dry, sugary pieces such as garlic, nuts or spices burn fastest.
warum_wichtig: Explains why garlic goes into the pan late and why black pan residue should not go into the sauce.
faustregeln: Small pieces late and over medium heat.
If it smells sharp and acrid, it is too late.
Cut off what is burnt rather than trying to season it away.
